introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Information and Communication Technologies, Paper 2 (0796), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Answer any SIX questions. All questions carry 17 marks each. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You will be marked on your ability to use good English, to organize information clearly and to use specialist vocabulary where appropriate. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

figures.legende: Bar chart (Gantt chart) of an ICT project, tasks A to D against time in months (axis graduated 1 to 12, labelled 1, 5 and 10): A runs from the start to the end of month 6, B from month 7 to month 11, C from month 1 to month 7, and D from month 6 to month 12.

incertitudes: Question 5 : points imprimés i = 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 ; ii = 2 + 2 = 4 ; iii = 5 x 1 = 5 ; dernière partie = 1 + 1 = 2 ; total 16, et non 17. Les points ne sont pas corrigés.
5 : le sujet imprime deux fois « (iii) » ; la dernière partie (fichier, nom et extension) est numérotée « iv » dans le JSON pour la distinguer du diagramme de projet.

5(iii) : le diagramme est un diagramme de Gantt sans quadrillage. Les durées sont lues sur les graduations de l'axe des mois : A de 0 à 6, B de 7 à 11, C de 1 à 7, D de 6 à 12 (lecture approximative à une graduation près). Chemin critique A puis D, marge de D nulle : ces réponses dépendent de cette lecture. Le sujet ne précise pas les dépendances ; elles sont déduites de l'enchaînement des barres (D commence quand A finit, B quand C finit).

questions.enonce_markdown:
The Ministry of Finance intends to develop an information system that will enable citizens check their fiscal situation and pay taxes online.

(a) What is the name of such an electronic service? (1 mark)

(b) State two other services that can be available to citizens on this platform. (2 marks)

(c) Describe one advantage and one limitation of this platform. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(a) Name of the service (1 mark).** E-government (e-governance), here more precisely an e-tax (online tax declaration and payment) service.

**(b) Two other services (2 marks)** (any two): online application for and renewal of official documents (national identity card, passport, driving licence, birth certificate); online registration of a business; online payment of fines, bills and fees; online access to forms, laws and public tenders (e-procurement); online voter registration.

**(c) One advantage and one limitation (2 marks).**

- *Advantage:* citizens save time and transport costs, avoid long queues and can use the service 24 hours a day from home; it also makes the system more transparent and reduces corruption and errors.
- *Limitation:* it needs Internet access and computer skills, which many citizens, especially in rural areas, do not have (digital divide); it is also exposed to hacking, loss of confidential data and breakdowns of the system.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Describe two activities carried out in each of the following E-services.

(a) E-commerce. (2 marks)

(b) E-banking. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(a) E-commerce (2 marks)** (any two): buying and selling goods and services over the Internet (browsing an online catalogue, choosing items in a shopping cart and placing an order); paying online (bank card, mobile money) and receiving the delivery or tracking the order; advertising and customer feedback; online auctions.

**(b) E-banking (2 marks)** (any two): consulting the balance and statements of an account; transferring money between accounts or to other people; paying bills, taxes and school fees; applying for a loan or a cheque book, or buying airtime.

questions.enonce_markdown:
The diagram below is used by a project manager to control an ICT project.

![fig-1](gce-al-ict-2021-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_5_fig_1.png)

Determine:

(a) The critical path. (1 mark)

(b) Two dependent tasks. (1 mark)

(c) The activities that can be carried out concurrently. (1 mark)

(d) The slack time of D. (1 mark)

(e) Two functions of a project manager. (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown:
The chart is a Gantt (bar) chart. Reading the bars on the month graduations: A runs from the start to the end of month 6 (6 months), B from month 7 to month 11 (4 months), C from month 1 to month 7 (6 months) and D from month 6 to month 12 (6 months). The project therefore ends at month 12.

**(a) Critical path (1 mark).** **A then D** (A: months 0 to 6, D: months 6 to 12): it is the longest chain of tasks that must follow one another (12 months), so it fixes the duration of the project and any delay on A or D delays the whole project. The other chain, C then B (months 1 to 11, 10 months), is shorter.

**(b) Two dependent tasks (1 mark).** D depends on A (D starts when A ends, at the end of month 6) and B depends on C (B starts when C ends, at the end of month 7).

**(c) Concurrent activities (1 mark).** Tasks that overlap in time can be carried out at the same time: A and C (months 1 to 6) and B and D (months 7 to 11); C and D also overlap during month 7.

**(d) Slack time of D (1 mark).** **0 months.** D is on the critical path: it starts as soon as A ends and finishes at month 12, the end of the project, so it can be neither delayed nor lengthened without delaying the project. (By comparison B has 1 month of slack, since it ends at month 11.)

**(e) Two functions of a project manager (1 mark)** (any two): planning the project and scheduling its tasks; allocating and managing resources (staff, equipment, budget); monitoring progress and controlling costs and quality; leading and motivating the team; managing risks and reporting to the client and stakeholders.

questions.enonce_markdown:
A file is specified in a computer by the file name and an extension:

(a) What does the file name represent? (1 mark)

(b) How does the extension help in file management? (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(a) File name (1 mark).** The name given to the file to identify it, so that the user and the operating system can recognise, find and open it (for example `report`, which must be unique in its folder).

**(b) Extension (1 mark).** The characters after the dot (for example `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.jpg`, `.exe`) show the type or format of the file, so the operating system knows which application must open it and what icon to display; it also lets users sort, search and filter files by type.
